title: Two users of remains
hook: Different organisms use a carcass in different ways.

knows: Animals interact with other organisms and their surroundings.
doesNotKnow: A vulture tears and eats pieces of a carcass; a fungus grows through remains and breaks down material. Which one is the scavenger in this example?

misconception: One observation or model rule gives a complete answer about nature.
objective: A vulture tears and eats pieces of a carcass; a fungus grows through remains and breaks down material. Which one is the scavenger in this example?

claims.text: A vulture tears and eats pieces of a carcass; a fungus grows through remains and breaks down material. Which one is the scavenger in this example? In this example the vulture consumes pieces of the carcass, while the fungus breaks down organic material. Both act on remains, but the illustrated actions differ.
